name: flow/toggle-flip
title: Toggle flip
desc_vi: Công tắc cỡ lớn bị ép nhẹ rồi núm trượt sang bên kia có độ vọt, màu nền công tắc đổi theo, quầng sáng nhấp một lần rồi thở nhẹ.
params_vi: direction: on | off (trạng thái đích) · label: chữ dưới công tắc (rỗng = ẩn) · size: bề rộng công tắc, % bề rộng khung (40) · duration: độ dài gốc 4 s (quyết định thời gian giữ và lúc mờ ra) · bg, fg, surface, border, brand, accent, muted, knob: màu
notes: Order, times and eases as in the source (stage 0.4 s power2.out; press scaleX 0.94 / scaleY 1.06 for 2 x 0.1 s power1.inOut ending where the flip starts; flip at 0.5 s, 0.25 s, back.out(1.9) for the knob (150 % of its width) and the track colour; knob scale 1 -> 1.08 yoyo repeat 1 over 0.1125 s per half; glow pulse 0 -> 1 -> 0 over 0.075 s per half right after the flip; breathing glow to 0.32 with 0.75 s per half and floor(HOLD / 0.75) - 1 repeats, 0.75 s = the source's 1.5 x the default 0.5 s beat; stage fade out 0.5 s at duration - 0.5 s; the whole envelope shrinks together when duration < 1.4 s). All cqw / cqh sizes are computed from the target box (size = percent of its width), so the block also works inside a smaller card like the source demo (768 x 432 card, size 55). The track colour crossfade was a CSS custom property (--tf-mix) inside color-mix(); it is now a second track layer in the brand colour whose opacity is tweened with the same ease (same blend, and the border blends 40 % toward the brand colour as in the source), which also means the back.out overshoot cannot make the colour invalid for a few frames as the source's negative color-mix percentages would. The knob colour is its own param (source: --surface token, whose fallback differs from the track's). Dropped: the aria-pressed attribute switch and the hf:sfx 'click-soft' event (no audio in the kit). Font: the film's font instead of Inter; label default is Vietnamese (source: Auto-save). The root takes the radius of its target (border-radius: inherit) so a rounded card clips the background. direction on = starts off and flips on, off = the reverse, as in the source.
